column2: A defective calf or sheep may not be sacrificed; any evil defect explains the broad blemish category and its abhorrent status.
Either man or woman in any given city may violate the covenant by evil before the Lord; both sexes and location remain.
Other gods, sun, moon and heaven's array are served and worshipped against what He commanded; the selected third-person divine reference remains.
A report requires diligent investigation and establishment that the abomination truly occurred before the ensuing sentence.
The man or woman is brought out and stoned to death; no unexpressed gate location is added.
Two or three witnesses support a capital sentence, while one cannot; the explicit alternative and prohibition remain.
Witnesses act first, then all the people, in removing the evil person; the sequence of hands remains.
Four paired case categories remain: blood, judgment, injury and dispute. Difficulty leads to the chosen name-place for adjudication.
column3: Injury for haphe may cover an affliction or lesion as well as a blow; the legal category needs specialist review.

column2: Levitical priests and the current judge investigate and declare judgment; the selected investigative agents are retained.
The announced decision from the chosen place must be followed with diligent observance of everything legislated.
Law and judgment govern action with no rightward or leftward departure, preserving both authority terms and directions.
Presumptuous refusal of the ministering priest or current judge incurs death and removal of the evil person from Israel.
All the people hear, fear and cease ungodly conduct; the selected final conduct term remains.
After entry, inheritance and residence, Israel may express a wish for a ruler like surrounding nations; ruler follows archon rather than inserting king.
The ruler must be the Lord's chosen brother, not a foreigner; appointment is emphatic and the kinship explanation remains.
He must not multiply horses or return people to Egypt for horses; the command never to return by that route remains.
Multiplying wives, a turning heart and excessive silver and gold are prohibited, preserving all three clauses.
The ruler writes this second law in a scroll from the Levitical priests, retaining the selected deuteronomion expression.
column3: Whether copy of this law better represents deuteronomion here requires fuller lexical review; second law is provisional, not a claim about a separate legal authority.

column2: The scroll remains with him for lifelong reading, learning fear and performing all commands and ordinances.
A heart not raised above brothers and no deviation from commands serve long rule for him and his sons; both purposes and succession remain.
The Levitical priests and whole tribe lack territorial share; the Lord's offerings are their edible inheritance.
The selected singular his and him remain after the plural opening, as in 10:9.
column3: The collective Levi reference remains a syntactic question for reader clarification; no unmarked pluralization is made.

column2: Calf or sheep offerings yield foreleg, cheeks and stomach to the priest; all three anatomical portions remain.
column3: The precise foreleg cut and enustron stomach compartment require specialist anatomical review; generic stomach is provisional.

column2: Firstfruits of grain, wine, oil and first fleece all go to him; the four categories remain.
Divine choice from all tribes establishes standing, ministry and blessing in His name for him and his sons among Israel.
A Levite may come from his sojourning town by personal desire to the chosen place, retaining origin and motive.
He ministers equally with the Levite brothers standing there before the Lord; the comparative right remains.
An allotted portion is eaten apart from the ancestral-family sale, preserving the difficult selected exception.
column3: The property-sale expression and its relationship to the portion require specialist legal and syntactic review; no detailed property rule is invented.

column2: The inherited land is not an occasion to learn the nations' abominable practices, retaining the prohibition of learning to do them.
Purifying children by fire, divination, spoken omens, auguries and sorcery remain distinct selected practices.
column3: The precise distinctions among divinatory roles need historical lexical review; fire purification is not silently replaced by a different wording tradition.

column2: Spell-chanting, mediumship, portents and inquiry of the dead remain four categories.
column3: Medium renders the contextual role of engastrimythos provisionally; the term's historical manner of speech and practice is not independently researched here.

column2: Every practitioner is abhorrent, and these practices explain removal of the nations; the stated scope and reason remain.
Perfect before the Lord retains the demand for completeness without an added theological definition.
The nations listen to omens and divinations, whereas the Lord has not granted Israel that course; both prohibited sources remain.
A prophet like Moses arises from the brothers and must be heard; no reception-based identification is inserted into the translation.
The Horeb assembly's request concerns no further voice or great fire lest they die, retaining the first-person plural quotation.
The Lord affirms that all they said is right, preserving the totality of the approval.
God raises the prophet, puts His singular word in his mouth and directs his speech; singular word is not harmonized to words.
Failure to hear the prophet's speech in God's name brings divine retribution, preserving the explicit agent and consequence.

Propose a word which I did not command him to speak. The selected negative qualifies commanded, whereas inherited commanded him not to speak incorrectly turns absence of authorization into an explicit prohibition. The alternative other-gods speech and death sentence remain.
The inward question asks how to recognize a word the Lord has not spoken; its negative is retained.
Nonoccurrence and nonfulfillment identify the unauthorized word and the prophet's ungodliness; both negatives remain.
column3: Inherited you shall not spare him for ouk aphexesthe autou requires fuller lexical and syntactic review; abstaining or holding back from him may be involved, and the familiar fear formula is not substituted.

column2: Removal of nations and possession of their cities and houses introduces the refuge-city instruction.
Three cities are set apart within the given land, preserving number and location.
The route is marked and territory divided in three for a refuge accessible to every slayer.
Unintentional killing without prior hatred qualifies for flight and life; both conditions remain.
The woodland example retains the jolted hand, iron slipping from wood, accidental death and refuge.
column3: The selected wood can concern handle or struck wood; the inherited wording preserves the ambiguity rather than specifying an unverified mechanical reconstruction.

column2: Long distance risks pursuit by a heated avenger and death of one not liable to a capital sentence, because no prior hatred existed.
The three-city requirement is repeated as the reasoned command, not shortened away.
Border enlargement and receipt of all promised land introduce the condition for further cities.
Hearing, love and lifelong walking in all ways accompany adding three more cities to the first three.
The arrangement prevents innocent bloodshed and bloodguilt within the given land, retaining both results.
Hatred, ambush, rising against the neighbour and a fatal blow distinguish intentional killing even if the killer flees to refuge.
The home city's elders retrieve and deliver the killer to the blood-avenging kinsman for death; all agents remain.
The eye must not spare; cleansing innocent blood from Israel is naturally rendered cleansing its guilt, with guilt supplied to express the legal consequence.
The neighbour's ancestral boundaries in the allotted land must not be moved; the inherited establishment is explicit.
A single witness is insufficient across injustice, trespass and sin; every matter is established by two and three witnesses in the selected conjunction pattern.
An unrighteous witness accuses a person of ungodliness, setting up the inquiry.
Both disputants stand before the Lord, priests and current judges; all three settings of authority remain.
Judges investigate accurately and identify false testimony against a brother before imposing the next sentence.
The false witness receives what he wickedly planned for his brother, and the evil person is removed.
Those remaining hear and fear and cease such conduct, preserving the deterrent result.
Life, eye, tooth, hand and foot are paired with their equivalents, following the no-pity instruction; all five pairs remain.
Horse, rider and superior numbers must not cause fear because the deliverer from Egypt is present; the selected rider is not changed to chariot.
The priest approaches and addresses the people as battle draws near, preserving his particular role.
Heart-faintness, fear, brokenness and turning away are all prohibited in the priest's address.
The Lord goes before and with Israel to fight alongside it and save it; all relations of presence and action remain.
A new house not dedicated exempts its builder from battle lest another dedicate it after his death.
A planted vineyard not yet enjoyed gives the parallel exemption; fruit is contextual English for enjoying its yield.
Betrothal without taking the wife gives the third exemption, retaining the stated risk of another man taking her.
Fearful and faint-hearted men return home lest their fear affect a brother's heart, preserving the interpersonal reason.
After the scribes finish speaking, army leaders are appointed to lead the people; the sequence remains.
Approaching a city for war begins with calling its people out in peace, preserving the offer before the alternatives.
A peaceful answer and opening lead to tribute and subjection for all inhabitants, retaining both obligations.
Refusal to hear and warfare lead to siege, preserving the conditional distinction.
After divine delivery every male is killed by sword; the stated violent scope remains explicit.
Propose livestock for generic ktene in the spoil list, retaining women, dependent households, all city contents and goods separately.
column3: The scope of aposkeue and apartia in this captive/spoil context remains open for specialist review; the categories are not collapsed or globally normalized.

column2: These terms apply to very distant cities outside the named nations, preserving the geographical restriction.
For cities of the nations whose land is inherited, nothing breathing is kept alive; the contrast is retained without softening.
All seven selected nations remain, with Girgashites last in this list and emphatic devotion to destruction.
The stated purpose is preventing instruction in abominations and consequent sin against the Lord, without added justification.
Food-bearing trees are protected during long siege, and the question whether a field-tree is a man remains a question.
column3: The final tree/man and siege construction needs further syntactic review, especially the force of from before you; inherited before you remains provisional.

column2: Known nonfood trees may be cut for siegeworks until delivery of the hostile city, retaining both the tree distinction and duration.
